newsitem.title: UK: Mackie shares drop as bid talks fail.
newsitem.headline: Mackie shares drop as bid talks fail.

text.p: Shares in Mackie International Group Plc dropped on Tuesday after the engineering company said talks on a possible takeover offer had been terminated.
The stock was down 37-1/2p at 146 by 1555 GMT.
In a brief statement, Mackie said talks following the bid approach it revealed last week had come to nothing.
"It has become apparent that the two parties involved were unlikely to reach agreement," it said, "and negotiations have therefore been terminated."

Mackie's statement last week noted a gain in its shares and said it had received an approach which may lead to an offer. However, it said any such offer would have to be at a premium to its then current share price of 160p.
